title: API Design Review - Payments
summary: Reviewed v2 payment API design. Webhook structure needs rework. Decided on idempotency key approach for retries. OAuth2 scope updates approved.
decisions: Webhook payloads to follow events API pattern (type, timestamp, data)
New OAuth2 scopes: payment:read and payment:write
Rate limiting: 1000 req/min per API key
transcription: [14:00] Alex Rivera: Walking through the new payment API design. Key changes: unified endpoint, better error codes, idempotency support. [14:05] Rachel Zhao: The webhook payload structure is inconsistent with our other APIs. We should standardize. [14:08] Alex Rivera: Agreed. What's the pattern we're standardizing on? [14:10] Rachel Zhao: The events API pattern we established last quarter. Event type, timestamp, data payload. [14:13] Tom Bradley: On idempotency - we're using request headers, correct? [14:15] Alex Rivera: Yes, Idempotency-Key header. UUID v4 recommended. [14:18] Tom Bradley: TTL on those keys? [14:20] Alex Rivera: 24 hours for now. We can adjust based on usage. [14:25] Rachel Zhao: OAuth scopes need updating too. We need payment:read and payment:write. [14:28] Alex Rivera: I'll add those to the spec.

risks.description: Breaking change may affect existing integrations
